description: NaFe₂O₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₅ square pyramids, edges with three FeO₆ octahedra, edges with five equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent FeO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-17°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.37 Å. There are three inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.32 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted FeO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-78°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.17 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine FeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.25 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra, edges with ten ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Fe atoms to form OFe₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, edges with ten OFe₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-6°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramid, edges with nine ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-18°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Fe atoms to form OFe₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, edges with ten OFe₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₄ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids, and edges with ten ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-18°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Fe₃ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-88°.
